title: Nike Vomero 18 - Men's

description.text: Performance powerhouse! Optimise your daily run with the Nike Vomero 18. Featuring a new dual-density midsole with ZoomX foam stacked on top of ReactX foam for a comfortable ride, these upgraded shoes let you push boundaries and run beyond limits. The engineered mesh upper keeps you feeling soft and cool with every giant leap, while the plush tongue and lining wrap your feet in added snugness. Offering maximum cushioning and comfort, the Nike Vomero 18 ensures your every stride is a step towards running greatness. Redesigned podular outsole delivers traction, durability, and support. Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm. Weight: Approx. 9 oz. When every mile matters, the Nike Vomero 18 delivers the kind of plush, energized ride that keeps you moving longer and feeling better at the finish. Built around a dual-density midsole that stacks ZoomX foam on top of ReactX foam, it pairs cloud-like softness with responsive bounce — whether you're logging daily training miles or pushing through a longer distance effort. An engineered mesh upper keeps the ride breathable and light, while a plush tongue and lining wrap the foot in a secure, comfortable fit from the first step. Dual-density midsole: ZoomX foam stacked over ReactX foam for maximum cushioning and energy return. Engineered mesh upper for breathability and a soft, lightweight feel. Plush tongue and interior lining for a snug, comfortable wrap. Redesigned podular outsole delivers traction, durability, and support. Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm. Weight: Approx. 9 oz. Size & Fit Guidance The Vomero 18 fits true to size for most runners and offers a generous toe box that accommodates natural foot splay. Runners who typically wear a wide width note that the standard fit works well for them. For those who prefer a little extra room through the forefoot, sizing up a half size is a comfortable option. Best For Runners and walkers who prioritize maximum cushioning and all-day comfort, from daily training miles and long runs to casual wear and extended time on your feet. Cushioning & Road Feel The stacked ZoomX-over-ReactX midsole creates a noticeably soft, bouncy underfoot sensation that runners consistently describe as effortless and smooth. The redesigned podular outsole provides confident grip on road surfaces, keeping each stride controlled from heel strike through toe-off. Break-In & Durability Comfort is immediate with the Vomero 18 — reviewers consistently note the shoe feels great right out of the box with no adjustment period needed. The cushioning holds up well over repeated use, with many runners returning for additional pairs across multiple colorways as a sign of lasting performance.

reviews.comments: Comfortable plush good for running or all day use great daily trainer.
Comfortable, stylish and easy to clean. Lots of cushioning. Good value for the price. I have three pairs.
Super nice and comfortable when walking for a long time (museum type of walking).
